subject: POC next steps & RACI -- HorizonCare trial
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@horizoncare.com>, James O'Leary <james.oleary@horizoncare.com>
Cc: procurement <procure@horizoncare.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 20:30:00 -0700
Subject: POC next steps & success criteria (recap from today's call)

Hi Sarah & James —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Wanted to capture next steps and align on success criteria so we can get the POC scheduled. Key points below and a short ask at the end.

Summary of the call:
- Objective: 2-week POC to validate Redwood inference for HorizonCare's patient messaging pipeline (secure clinical summaries + triage suggestions).
- Scope: 3 sample workflows (inbound triage, follow-up message generation, summarization of intake forms).
- Success criteria (customer-proposed):
  - Accuracy: generated summaries meet clinical reviewer acceptance >= 85% on 50 sampled items.
  - Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 300ms for 512-token requests.
  - Security/compliance: no PHI leaves VPC; audit logs available for requests.
- Data: you will provide a sanitized sample dataset (50 records) and a short evaluation rubric.

Proposed Redwood next steps:
1) Draft RACI and timeline for the POC (who owns infra/app/security/procurement) — attached.
2) Provide access to a private-hosted POC endpoint (VPC-friendly) and onboarding doc.
3) Kickoff call to finalize technical requirements and timeline.

Ask: Can you confirm the success criteria above and confirm a preferred kickoff window (next Wed/Thu)? Also loop in anyone from engineering who will own infra/network access.

Attachments: HorizonCare_POC_RACI.xlsx (RACI draft), redwood_poc_timeline.pdf (proposed schedule)

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123
From: Dr. Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@horizoncare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, James O'Leary <james.oleary@horizoncare.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC next steps & success criteria (recap from today's call)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications and additions from our side:

- Success criteria: we agree on the acceptance threshold but would like to add a qualitative reviewer score for summaries (scale of 1-5) and a tie-breaker rule if scores fall in the 80-85% band.
- Latency: 300ms p95 is ideal; we can accept up to 400ms during heavy load tests but would expect adjustments in config/quantization recommendations.
- Security: our security and compliance team will require the SOC2 evidence and a brief on data residency during the POC. I'll loop them in separately.

We can do kickoff Thursday (Mar 12) 10:00-11:00 PT. I'll add our Engineering lead, James, and CC procurement to make initial procurement checklist quicker.

Thanks — looking forward.

—Sarah
Dr. Sarah Patel
Director of Clinical Innovation, HorizonCare
sarah.patel@horizoncare.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@horizoncare.com>, James O'Leary <james.oleary@horizoncare.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, procurement <procure@horizoncare.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC next steps & success criteria (recap from today's call)

Great — thanks Sarah. Confirmed: kickoff Thu Mar 12 10:00-11:00 PT.

I've attached an updated RACI and a proposed timeline (same files mentioned earlier). Quick summary of ownership we propose so we can be explicit during kickoff:

- Customer (HorizonCare):
  - App owners / product: provide evaluation rubric, clinical reviewer pool, sanitized sample data, acceptance decision.
  - Procurement: review and approve temporary POC terms; provide PO if required.
  - Security: run SOC2 checklist and confirm data residency controls.
- Redwood Inference:
  - Infra / Endpoint provisioning: Redwood will provision and manage the private POC endpoint in a HorizonCare-approved VPC/subnet. (Owner: Lauren Bishop)
  - Integration support: provide onboarding and data ingestion guidance (Owner: Marissa Cole).
  - Security & compliance evidence: provide SOC2 report excerpt and logs export process (Owner: Rishi Malhotra).

Action items before kickoff (Mar 12 10:00 PT):
- HorizonCare to share sanitized sample dataset + rubric (Sarah) — due by Wed EOD.
- Procurement to confirm PO/contract path (procurement) — tentative due Thu EOD.
- Redwood to confirm infra provisioning checklist and kickoff agenda (Marissa, Lauren, Rishi) — done (attached).

Attachments: HorizonCare_POC_RACI.xlsx (updated), redwood_poc_timeline.pdf

I'll cover onboarding and timeline in the kickoff; Lauren will cover environment provisioning requirements and Rishi will take the security checklist.

Best,

Marissa
